name: Check that Claude Code runs on your ByteChef server
description: Asks Claude Code to run five read-only checks on your ByteChef server (working directory, CLI version, operating system, directory listing and a shell command) and report them in a PASS/FAIL table, so you can confirm the Claude Code component works before you build on it.
shortDescription: Confirm that the Claude Code component runs on your server with a PASS/FAIL report.
keyFeatures: Read-only checks run by the Claude Code agent in its own temporary workspace on the server
PASS/FAIL report in the execution log
A Chat step with an empty MCP Servers slot and a Skills property, ready for your MCP servers and skills
prerequisites: Server setting bytechef.component.claude-code.enabled=true (BYTECHEF_COMPONENT_CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLED), which registers the Claude Code component
Claude Code CLI installed on the ByteChef server, on the PATH of the user that runs ByteChef
Anthropic API key in the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable of ByteChef, or a logged-in Claude Code CLI
idealFor: Administrators of self-hosted ByteChef who enabled the Claude Code component and want to check the setup before workflow builders use it.
steps: Trigger: the workflow starts when you click Test in the workflow editor.
Run the checks: the Claude Code agent runs five read-only checks on the server and answers with a PASS/FAIL table. If the Claude Code CLI is missing, the step fails with a setup message.
Log the report: the Logger step prints the table to the execution log.
